question: A spell checker compares the typed word "helo" with every word in its dictionary. For each pair it needs the fewest single-letter edits. What do the subproblems depend on?
options: Two positions: how much of each word has been used
One position: how far into the typed word
explanation: An edit can move through either word independently, so the state is a pair (i, j) of prefix lengths. That is a 2-D table, filled from smaller prefixes to larger ones.
